Field shading = last-12-month production (NSTA PPRS, May 2025–Apr 2026): solid/dark = high rate, faint dotted = no reported production. Decom lens inverts it: ceased fields highlighted, darker = ceased more recently (from last reported PPRS month — actual cessation, not forecast COP). Onshore outlines are NSTA field determinations. West Newton is pre-determination (appraisal in PEDL183, Rathlin op.) — its outline is indicative, not licensed geometry.

Sources & caveats

Sources: NSTA Open Data (OGL v3): UKCS offshore fields (478) + England onshore fields (61, incl. CBM). West Newton: indicative appraisal outline, PEDL183. Gas grid: NSTA offshore pipelines (active) + OSM onshore NTS; terminals & platforms: NSTA infrastructure points; storage sites indicative. Production & cessation dates: NSTA PPRS (history to Apr 2026). Terminal flows: National Gas instantaneous flow API. Basemap © OpenStreetMap contributors © CARTO.
